tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_riki_tricks_of_the_: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.

Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.
The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.
Backstab damage is applied to all units hit.

Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_riki_bio: Riki was born middle child to the great dynasty of Tahlin. With an older brother groomed for the throne, and a younger brother coddled and kept, Riki, the small middle son, seemed born for the art of invisibility.  It was an art he cultivated, and one which ultimately saved his life on the night that his people were betrayed and his family slaughtered. Of all the royal line, he alone escaped, small and agile, unassuming, using smoke as cover. He cut his way out of the royal grounds, using the advantage of surprise, quietly slitting the throats of one enemy warrior after another. Now free of his royal responsibilities, Riki uses his talents in service to a new trade: Stealth Assassin. He silences his enemies, sharpening his skills, hoping to one day take revenge on those who killed his family and robbed him of his birthright.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_riki_hype: Riki stalks the battlefield, unseen by the enemy. He chooses his moment carefully and bursts forth in a puff of silencing smoke, stabbing at his foes before they even know he's there.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_riki_npedesc1: Remains permanently invisible until the moment to strike

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Does not break {{A|Riki|Cloak and Dagger}}'s {{M|invisibility}} upon cast, but not other invisibility sources.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Teleport}}
*#* [[Teleports]] Riki a random angle behind the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy.
*#* Cannot be cast on the following units:
*#** {{M|Buildings}}
*#** {{M|Couriers}} of all {{M|factions}}.
*#** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*#** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*#** {{M|Ward-type units}}
*#** Does not {{M|disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
*#** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*#*** However, Blink Strike's ability effects are still visible to everyone.
*# Applies the {{M|movement speed}} slow.
*# Applies {{A|Riki|Backstab}} of its corresponding level.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|riki_blinkstrike}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#* Grants self a {{#var:Blink Strike type1 value3}}-second buff that applies the following ability effects:
*#** Applies {{A|Riki|Backstab}} of its corresponding level, regardless of the affected enemy unit's {{M|facing angle}}.
*#** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}} 
*#*** Breaks {{A|Riki|Cloak and Dagger}}'s invisibility upon applying the [[instant attack]] component.
*#*** The instant attack with a flat {{#var:Blink Strike type1 value2}} {{M|physical}} {{M|attack damage}} as one damage instance within the {{M|combat log}}.
*#**** Does not procs {{M|attack modifiers}}.
*#**** Does not have {{M|True Strike}}.
*#**** Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
*#**** Has the following interactions with Riki's [[base attack time]]:
*#***** Does not apply the instant attack component if Riki casts Blink Strike between attacks.

* This ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Invisible}}
*** Riki will keep turning invisible as long as he is not affected by {{M|break}} sources.
**** Immediately turns Riki invisible in the following conditions:
***** Upon {{M|reincarnation}} sources proc.
***** When Riki {{M|respawns}}.
*** During the {{M|fade delay}}, the affected unit can still attack and cast abilities.
*** {{Symbol|bonus t1l}} Grants bonus {{M|movement speed}} while fully invisible.
*** Does not grant {{M|phase movement}}.
*** Sources with fade delays utilize the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|[[invisible]]}} buff.
**** Buff sources of the same modifier do not stack, the longer duration buff takes precedence when the same modifier is applied.
**** Riki can pick up, drop items, or [[toggle]] itmes {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} / {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}} without breaking invisibility.
**** The Cloak and Dagger invisibility breaks upon {{M|attack point}}, including triggering {{M|Instant Attack}}. Casting any abilities do not break invisibility.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus xp}}
*** This ability component is an {{M|on-death effect}}, and does not grant Riki the bonus [[experience]] when the dying enemy hero has {{M|reincarnation}} sources.
*** Considers {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}} as heroes; other {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.

fields.value: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.

fields.value: Smoke Screen: Silenced. Vision Reduced. Missing x% of attacks. Move Speed slowed.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-4-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-4-2.png|84px]]
** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Smoke Screen cast range}}+{{#var:Smoke Screen value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t1r}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Smoke Screen cast range}}+{{#var:Smoke Screen value1 tal}}}}|10tal}})-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].

* {{Symbol|Aura}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|riki_smoke_screen}}
** Creates a non-lingering negative [[aura]] at centerpoint [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]] that applies the following ability effects within the radius upon cast:
*** Recasting the ability do not update the current ability values on already affected enemy units, but refreshes its duration.
*** {{M|Silence}}
*** {{Symbol|Blind}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light}}
**** [[Evasion#Stacking|Stacks]] additively with other [[blind]] sources and multiplicatively with {{M|evasion}} sources.
**** The debuff-affected attacking unit's miss chance uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Smoke Screen value2}}|lvl=4}}.
** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
*** Smoke Screen of different sources works independently of each other.
*** Multiple overlapping Smoke Screen radius do not stack.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** {{cf|shdnotes}} Enemy units within the Smoke Screen radius are now {{M|untargetable}} by their allies.
*** Any attack or {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeting abilities of their allies that are already in its {{M|attack animation|text=attack}} or {{M|cast animation}} is canceled.
*** Does not affect the following properties of the enemy units within the radius:
**** {{M|Selection box}}.
**** Does not prevent {{M|Spell Reflection}} sources.
**** Does not {{M|disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}} for enemy units.
**** Certain abilities can [[Non-targetable#Bypassing Unselectability|bypass unselectability]] conditionally, while almost every other ability cast by their ally treats the affected enemy targets as if they were invisible.

* {{Symbol|Channeling}}
** While [[channeling]] {{A|Riki|Tricks of the Trade}}, Smoke Screen has the following ability effects as long as the {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted location is within the {{M|cast range}}:
*** Has an {{M|instant cast}} time.
*** Does not require {{M|turn rate|text=facing}} the area-targeted location to cast.
*** Except with {{Code|▣ Channeled Abilities Require Hold/Stop}} disabled, Riki cannot cast Smoke Screen while channeling Tricks of the Trade.

fields.value: The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Phases out of the world while striking random enemy units from behind in an area around him.

fields.value: Applies an ensured Backstab bonus attack damage, regardless of the enemy's facing angle.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value:
Enables casting Tricks of the Trade on allied units, Riki hides within and moves along with the unit-targeted allied unit with movement speed bonus upon cast.

Casting on an allied unit increases the max attack targets, the number of instant attacks, and its max duration.

Increases cast range.

buff3text
fields.value: Tricks of the Trade: Riki is hiding in your pocket! Movement speed is increased.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{M|Doubletap}} automatically casts the ability at the {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location.
** {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
*** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-4-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-4-2.png|84px]]
**** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Tricks of the Trade cast range}}+{{#var:Tricks of the Trade value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Tricks of the Trade cast range agh}}+{{#var:Tricks of the Trade value1}}}}|agh}})-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
**** {{M|Doubletap}} automatically casts the ability at the {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location.
** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} Enables Tricks of the Trade casting on allied units.
**** When unit-targeted, all ability effects are now centered on the unit-targeted ally, follows it as it moves, and continues at its {{M|death}} location upon death.
***** Other ability effects affecting Riki still apply.
***** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes; ally {{M|Couriers}} and other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.

* The ability cast and {{M|channeling}} component applies the following ability effects as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
*#* Grants a 2-second 450-radius [[flying vision]] centered around the targeted location.
*# {{M|Disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
*# {{Symbol|Channeling}}
*#* Has the following properties while channeling:
*#** {{M|Hidden}}
*#** {{M|Invulnerability}}
*#** {{M|Phase movement}}.
*#** {{M|Untargetable}}
*#** {{A|Riki|Smoke Screen}} has the following ability effects as long as the {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted location is within the {{M|cast range}}:
*#*** Has an {{M|instant cast}} time.
*#*** Does not require {{M|turn rate|text=facing}} the area-targeted location to cast.
*#*** Continues with all ability effects even when the channeling is interrupted.
*#**** However, newly {{M|shift-queue}} orders now interrupt and cancel Tricks of the Trade.
*#* {{Symbol|Channeling|f}}
*#** The following item abilities specifically always interrupts the channeling component:
*#*** {{A|Shadow Blade|Shadow Walk}}
*#*** {{A|Shiva's Guard|Arctic Blast}}
*#** Reappears at the center of the radius after when the channeling is interrupted in any way.
*# Applies {{A|Riki|Backstab}} of its corresponding level, regardless of the affected enemy unit's {{M|facing angle}}.
*# {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*#* Sets Riki's attack damage to {{#var:Tricks of the Trade value5}}.
*#* [[Instant attacks]] in {{#expr:{{#var:Tricks of the Trade value3}}/({{#var:Tricks of the Trade value4}}-1) round3}} ({{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Tricks of the Trade type3 value1 agh}}/({{#var:Tricks of the Trade type3 value2 agh}}-1) round3}}|agh}})-second intervals on enemy targets within the radius, starting immediately upon cast, over its duration.
*#** The instant attack damage is defined as:
*#*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Instant Attack|InstantAtk]] {{=}} {{#var:Tricks of the Trade value5}} + (([[Attack damage#Base Attack Damage|BaseAtk]] + [[Agility|ΣAgi]] + [[Bonus Attack Damage|BonusAtk]]) × 0 OR {{ValueColor||{{#var:Tricks of the Trade value6 tal}}|tal|x}})}}
*#*** {{cf|talnotes}} Learning the {{ValueColor||base attack damage as instant attack damage bonus|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2r}} does not update the current active instance.
*#**** Considers the following attack damage sources:
*#***** {{M|Base attack damage}}.
*#***** {{M|Bonus attack damage}}.
*#** Proc any {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-cast effects}} as per normal.
*#** Do not have {{M|True Strike}}.
*#** Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
*#** Specifically do not break the following {{M|invisibility}} sources:
*#*** {{A|Smoke of Deceit|Disguise}}-based abilities.
*#*** {{A|Riki|Cloak and Dagger}}, regardless of the visual {{M|cooldown}} on the HUD.
*#* Affects the following units:
*#** {{M|Couriers}}
*#** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*#* Does not affect the following units:
*#** {{M|Invisible}} units.
<hr>
* {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
** {{cf|aghnotes}} The increased {{M|instant attack}} instances and increased duration only applied to an allied unit cast.

mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Invisible}}
*** Riki will keep turning invisible as long as he is not affected by {{M|break}} sources.
**** Immediately turns Riki invisible in the following conditions:
***** Upon {{M|reincarnation}} sources proc.
***** When Riki {{M|respawns}}.
*** During the {{M|fade delay}}, the affected unit can still attack and cast abilities.
*** {{Symbol|bonus t1l}} Grants bonus {{M|movement speed}} while fully invisible.
*** Does not grant {{M|phase movement}}.
*** Sources with fade delays utilize the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|[[invisible]]}} buff.
**** Buff sources of the same modifier do not stack, the longer duration buff takes precedence when the same modifier is applied.
**** Riki can pick up, drop items, or [[toggle]] itmes {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} / {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}} without breaking invisibility.
**** The Cloak and Dagger invisibility breaks upon {{M|attack point}}, including triggering {{M|Instant Attack}}. Casting any abilities do not break invisibility.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus xp}}
*** This ability component is an {{M|on-death effect}}, and does not grant Riki the bonus [[experience]] when the dying enemy hero has {{M|reincarnation}} sources.
*** Considers {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}} as heroes; other {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
